presentation.label: MIDI scene locks
presentation.summary: Scene locks for the MIDI tracks: hold SCENE A or B and turn a knob, then morph with the crossfader.
presentation.overview: Stock scenes lock audio tracks only. MIDI Scenes gives the eight MIDI tracks the same scene locks: hold SCENE A or SCENE B on a MIDI track and turn a knob on the NOTE, LFO, ARP, CTRL 1 or CTRL 2 page, and the crossfader morphs between the two scenes and sends the values as CCs. Locks are kept per Part, saved with the project and kept over a power cycle like stock's.
highlights: Hold-to-lock, the held scene's value on the knob, encoder press to clear, lock LEDs and lit scene pads, as on audio tracks.
The crossfader morphs each locked MIDI parameter between scenes A and B; changed values go out as CCs before the note.
CLEAR, COPY and PASTE SCENE carry the MIDI locks; Part Clear clears them.
Saved with the project in scenes.work, never in the Part: LFO designer shapes stay intact.
usage: Press MIDI and select a MIDI track. Assign a scene to SCENE A and another to SCENE B (hold the scene key, press a TRIG key).
Hold SCENE B and turn a knob, for example encoder A on CTRL 1: the knob shows the locked value. Release the scene key.
Move the crossfader from A to B: the locked parameter moves between its Part value and the lock and goes out as a CC.

access.location: MIDI track pages (NOTE, LFO, ARP, CTRL 1, CTRL 2) with SCENE A or SCENE B held
steps: Press MIDI and select a MIDI track with its TRACK key.
Hold SCENE A or SCENE B and press a TRIG key to assign a scene to that side.
Keep the scene key held and turn an encoder on a MIDI page to lock that parameter in the scene; press the encoder to clear the lock.
Release the scene key and move the crossfader to morph between the two scenes.

limitations: OS 1.40C, Modwerk base 0.7.4 or newer, over USB only: card firmware cannot include it.
Installed and run briefly on one MKII; the scene locks, the crossfader, saving and reloading are not yet tested on a unit.
A damaged scenes.work, or one from a newer version, is never overwritten: the project then starts with no MIDI scene locks and keeps none. Rename or delete the file on the card to start over.
Keep MIDI Scenes installed while you save, reload or copy projects that use it: without it scenes.work is not saved, reloaded or copied with the project.
Part Save and Reload leave the MIDI locks as they are; a Kit or a Part copy does not carry them.
Uses about 272 KB of the shared module memory (a lock table for each of the project's 64 Parts).

storage.label: Storage
storage.display: 5.4 KB of code, 0.7 KB of data and 266 KB of buffers; scenes.work on the card (262 KB a project)
storage.conditions: m68k-elf-size of scenes.s: 5,430 bytes of code, 654 of data, 271,920 of bss (64 lock tables of 4,096 bytes, a 4 KB read slot, the file buffer and the CRC table). Battery RAM: 9,984 bytes at 0x100f9800.

processing.label: ColdFire
processing.display: +0.2 points of the frame interrupt, +0.3 of the CPU meter; in use within noise
processing.conditions: MKII, base 0.7.4 development twin: device:price at rest; then eight MIDI tracks with a trig on every step, 480 locks, crossfader sweeps and pattern changes, alone and beside 14 modules (TESTING.md). MIDI channels off.

impact.conditions: MIDI tracks with scene locks while the crossfader moves.

cpu.rationale: At rest +0.2 points of the frame interrupt; in use with 480 locks and the crossfader sweeping, the CPU meter moved 0.1-0.2 points, within run-to-run noise.

memory.rationale: About 272 KB of the 768 KiB module memory all modules share.

cpuPrice.conditions: MKII, base 0.7.4 development twin 31d16f88, the owner's project A01 playing, installed and used nowhere, 8 s per reading; in use with 480 scene locks on eight MIDI tracks and the crossfader sweeping it read +0.1 (alone) and +0.0 (beside 14 other modules); MIDI channels off, so no CC was sent

tests.summary: MKII, base 0.7.4 development twin: installed as trials, hand-tested by the owner, CPU price +0.2 points at rest, in-use and stress runs with 480 locks alone and beside 14 modules, no skipped render, crash or stall. MIDI channels were off; save, reload and power cycle not tested.

license.declaration: Sam Banks' MIT rewrite from octabam with Modwerk's port changes, MIT. Stock sites are named by address, length and SHA-256 only. No firmware, extracted stock code or built images are included.

otUi.page: MIDI NOTE page, SCENE B held
otUi.setup: The owner's MKII over USB, 16 November 2026: a development twin of Modwerk base 0.7.4 (MAIN SHA-256 in imageSha256) booted from RAM, MIDI Scenes 0.3.0 installed as a 60-second trial (package SHA-256 f38ae755…), the owner's project on pattern A01, MIDI track 1, scene 1 on A and scene 9 on B, stopped transport. The unit's LCD framebuffer read over USB (npm run device session, png step), 256 x 128, two pixels a dot. The locks were cleared and the trial rolled back afterwards.
